value.rationale: The problem concerns stability of polynomial Galerkin approximations of natural finite mixtures of Hardy averages, beyond a single rate. The exact complete surviving singular-value list is a structural quantitative failure of norm convergence despite strong convergence; the cross-rate Cauchy matrix resolves interactions and cancellations and yields a nontrivial exact small secondary channel. The object and invariant are intrinsic, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
